data.name: Root

data.value: Manage persistent conversations and actual execution steps.

data.name: Skill

data.value: Manage explicitly enabled stdio MCP processes and inspect their real catalogs.

data.value: Manage independent file and network defaults.

data.name: List
data.value: List current records.

data.value: Read the selected record.

data.name: Remove

data.name: Models
data.value: Discover actual models without changing manual bindings.

data.name: Test
data.value: Run a real connection or generation check.

data.name: Default
data.value: Select the default for new conversations.

data.name: Create
data.value: Create a persistent conversation.

data.name: Send
data.value: Submit a turn. --wait observes; --cancel-on-exit owns cancellation.

data.name: Retry
data.value: Retry an unsuccessful turn without replaying unknown effects.

data.name: Turn
data.value: Read a turn without private provider continuation state.

data.name: Events
data.value: Read ordered durable steps after a sequence cursor.

data.name: Archive
data.value: Read original compacted context by conversation and archive identifiers, without private provider state.

data.name: ArchiveCharacters
data.value: Return 256 through 16000 characters per archive page. Default: 12000.

data.name: ArchiveMessageIndex
data.value: Read one original message by its zero-based archive index.

data.name: Cancel
data.value: Cancel this turn, not an independent game or job.

data.name: Rename
data.value: Rename without changing conversation content.

data.name: Mode
data.value: Change the explicit operation mode.

data.name: Export
data.value: Export public history to an explicitly selected JSON or text file.

data.name: Check
data.value: Inspect actual configured instructions and per-file warnings.

data.name: Add
data.value: Register an explicitly selected local directory.

data.name: Enable
data.value: Enable this registered source for future turns.

data.name: Disable
data.value: Disable this registered source for future turns.

data.name: Request
data.value: Run one foreground model request without conversation or tools.

data.name: Host
data.value: Inspect the actual assistant host and runtime mode.

data.name: OptionValue
data.value: Explicit {0} value.

data.name: OptionFlag
data.value: Enable {0} for this command.

data.name: OptionBoolean
data.value: Explicit true or false for {0}.

data.name: SecretArgumentsForbidden
data.value: Never put credentials in command arguments. Use --credential-stdin, --credential-prompt or --credential-env.

data.name: InvalidArguments
data.value: Invalid assistant command or typed option. Use --help for accepted syntax.

data.name: RevisionRequired
data.value: Read the current configuration, then supply --expected-revision.

data.name: ValueRequired
data.value: Supply --{0}.

data.name: SingleModelRequired
data.value: Select one model for this operation.

data.name: InputTooLarge
data.value: The input exceeds its bounded character budget.

data.name: SecretInputConflict
data.value: Choose one protected credential input method.

data.name: SecretInputRedirected
data.value: Use --credential-stdin for redirected credential input.

data.name: SecretPrompt
data.value: Credential:

data.name: DefaultGreeting
data.value: Reply with a short greeting.

data.name: ServiceNotFound
data.value: The configured service no longer exists.

data.name: BackgroundNotSupported
data.value: Core AI turns already manage their execution lifetime. Omit --background; use chat send and optionally --wait.

data.name: SecretInputDirectOnly
data.value: Interactive credential input is available only through direct CLI invocation, not MCP tools or background jobs.

data.name: AllowOperations
data.value: Authorize supported mutations only for this submitted goal and its explicit scope. This does not bypass product confirmations.

data.name: EffectsCheck
data.value: Check current Core state against a stopped turn's incomplete mutation intents without replaying calls.

data.name: Approve
data.value: Explicit true to approve or false to reject the exact operation fingerprint.

data.name: ToolConfirm
data.value: Record a user's decision for the exact pending operation. Model arguments cannot provide this decision.

data.name: ToolConfirmationRead
data.value: Read bounded pages of the exact pending operation, arguments and frozen review.

data.name: ApprovalRequired
data.value: Specify --approve true or --approve false for this exact confirmation.

data.name: FileRoots
data.value: Manage explicitly authorized local directories and their read/write modes.

data.name: Integration
data.value: Plan, install, inspect or remove product-owned Codex and Claude Code skills and MCP registration.

data.name: Plan
data.value: Inspect the exact targets, current ownership and binding before making changes.

data.name: Apply
data.value: Apply a current exact plan and report each installation result.

data.name: Status
data.value: Inspect installation ownership, current client configuration and data-root binding.

data.name: EffectsAcknowledge
data.value: Accept an exact remaining unknown effect after inspection, for new authorized goals only. Does not prove an outcome or permit replaying the old goal.

data.name: LocalInference
data.value: Manage launcher-owned embedded local model inference without a separately installed service.

data.name: UnloadLocalInference
data.value: Unload the idle embedded engine and its owned native model workers without altering model files.

data.name: PromptStdin
data.value: Read the prompt from redirected standard input (direct CLI only), up to 64000 characters.

data.name: PromptSourceConflict
data.value: Choose exactly one of --prompt, --prompt-file or --prompt-stdin.

data.name: PromptStdinDirectOnly
data.value: Prompt stdin is available only through direct CLI invocation; MCP stdin carries protocol messages.

data.name: PromptStdinRedirected
data.value: Pipe text into this command or use --prompt or --prompt-file.

data.name: PromptRequired
data.value: Supply --prompt, --prompt-file or --prompt-stdin.

data.name: WaitForTurn
data.value: Observe an existing turn without resubmitting it. --events writes ordered events to stderr; --after resumes a cursor. Observer timeout does not cancel the turn.

data.name: WaitOptionsInvalid
data.value: Use a nonnegative --after cursor and --timeout-seconds between 1 and 3600.

data.name: WaitTimeout
data.value: Observation timed out. The turn was not canceled or resubmitted; resume using its identifiers and event cursor.

data.name: ModelSelection
data.value: Actual model references when configuring; a saved model-binding ID when generating or choosing a conversation model. Repeat only when creating a service.

data.name: OutputTokens
data.value: Explicit positive output-token limit. request/chat override only this call; model save persists it. When omitted, use the saved setting or observed model capacity; unknown capacity leaves the provider default unchanged.

data.name: TimeoutSeconds
data.value: Request/turn deadline in seconds (1..3600); chat wait uses an observer-only deadline and does not cancel generation.

data.name: ClientKey
data.value: 32-digit GUID idempotency key. Repeating identical input returns the same turn; changed input with the same key is rejected.

data.name: ModelCalls
data.value: Maximum model calls in this turn (1..64), including context selection. This is not a limit on conversation messages.

data.name: Turns
data.value: Observe and control existing conversation turns.

data.name: Confirmations
data.value: Read and decide exact pending operation confirmations.

data.name: Effects
data.value: Inspect and acknowledge stopped-turn effects without replay.

data.name: UpdateConversation
data.value: Update explicit conversation fields in one revision-checked operation.

data.name: ConversationChangesRequired
data.value: Specify a title, instance, model, mode, file-access or network-access change.
